A flowchart showing the journey of a bill. From top to bottom: "Drafting", an arrow to a box "First Reading (Title read, no debate)", arrow to "Second Reading (General principles debated, vote taken)", arrow to "Committee Stage (Detailed clause-by-clause scrutiny, public hearings)", arrow to "Report Stage (Committee reports back, amendments considered)", arrow to "Third Reading (Final review, minor corrections, final vote)". An arrow then points sideways to "Concurrence in Upper House (Process repeats)", then an arrow pointing to a split path. Left path: "Presidential Assent (President signs) -> Becomes an Act". Right path: "President Vetoes -> Legislature can override with 2/3 majority -> Becomes an Act".
